title: Keep query text and values apart
summary: GraphQL: Keep query text and values apart. Change variable n to 7 without changing the query.
introduction: A variable lets one query be reused with different values. Its value is supplied separately.
learningObjectives: Keep query text and values apart with GraphQL
Change variable n to 7 without changing the query

blocks.text: In a practice folder run npm init -y and npm install graphql@16. Save one example as lesson.mjs and run node lesson.mjs. These examples execute queries locally and do not need an HTTP server.
Keep query text and values apart

blocks.title: Keep query text and values apart

blocks.text: The separate variable object provides n. GraphQL inserts that value into the field argument.
Change variable n to 7 without changing the query.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: A declared required variable must be supplied.
